generationPolicy: Stop additional generation tests while the routine-model path is affected; do not retry either unknown request or silently reroute it to another model.

officialSources.finding: Canonical Flash name is deepseek-flash; legacy deepseek-v4-flash remains accepted and routes to current Flash. Missing the legacy alias from /models does not establish that it is invalid.

inferenceBoundary: The reported Flash outage is consistent with both routine-node timeouts, but cannot establish the individual request execution or billing outcome. Successful /models authentication does not prove that generation is healthy or that account balance is sufficient.
actualUsageAndCost: Unknown for both requests; reservations are not measured usage or confirmed charges.
maintenance: New configuration defaults/examples now use canonical deepseek-flash. Existing explicit settings are preserved. No claim that renaming fixes this outage.
